title: Bluetooth: Connection Parameters tracking
description:
Add the current connection parameter as generated context information for each packet, with a link to where these connection parameters was applied from.

This requires the event counter to be valid in order to be applied correctly at the instant
Without this information we just say it is valid from having received the connection parameter update.

notes.body:
This is values fetched from the connection packet and should not be shown here.
The only relevant info here is `from_frame` which will point to where the values are fetched from.

commits_data.title: Bluetooth: Add connection parameters in frame context information to display
commits_data.message:
Bluetooth: Add connection parameters in frame context information to display

Add connection parameters in context information to display.
The connection parameters for the connection is important enough information
due to the time-division multiple access nature of Bluetooth, so having an in
frame pointer available is useful for debugging performance and timing related
problems.
Since the connection parameters are applied using instant then the event
counter is needed from the capture context in order to properly set this
information.
When this information is not available the connection parameters in frame is
set as active from the connection parameter update PDU, which is incorrect,
until the instant, but a good enough compromise without this information.

Signed-off-by: Joakim Andersson <joakim.andersson@nordicsemi.no>

bluetooth: Add event counter and event counter valid to context

Add event counter and event counter valid variables to the btle context.
This information has to come from the capture context, and the information
is useful to provide context information around LL control procedures with
instant.
